name: Full-scale Precision Study (Confound Fixed)
description: 4 models × 3 precisions × 6 prompts × 6 seeds × 3 temps × 4 orderings × 200 MMLU items, all using V0 enforce_eager

results.model_agreement: 3 of 4 models show item_id as largest; Gemma-2 shows elevated prompt_x_item (~0.09) pulling item_id share to 0.36

tables: Table 1: Variance component estimates (% of total) by model — 4×12 matrix showing each component per model plus pooled
Table 2: Accuracy means by precision level per model — confirms confound fix (三者差异<1pp vs MVP的8.5pp)
Table 3: Model-level G coefficients under current practice conditions
analysis:
Two-way ANOVA确认precision main effect在fix后从显著(p<0.001, η²=0.009)降为边际(p=0.03, η²=0.008)。Bootstrap CI for item_id share: [0.38, 0.48]。Gemma异常通过leave-one-model-out sensitivity analysis量化——移除Gemma后pooled item_id升至0.46。

修复float32 confound后，MVP中precision=0.0087的main effect基本维持（因为BF16/FP16本身仍有差异），但precision×item从0.072骤降至0.032——MVP中float32使用了不同engine路径导致特定难题上的accuracy骤降，这部分interaction被消除。item_id纯方差从0.584降至0.43：原来的0.584中约有10-12pp是precision×item和temperature×item interaction在单一precision条件下被吸收进item主效应（50 items时估计不稳定）。200 items的stratified sampling提供更稳定估计，residual从0.176升至0.21反映了更大item pool中的unmodeled item×condition microvariance。Gemma-2-9B-IT因其instruction-tuning风格对prompt wording异常敏感（已知其system prompt格式要求严格），prompt×item interaction偏高，拉低了该模型的item_id相对份额。整体G=0.42仍然很低，验证了current practice不可靠的核心论点。

name: Multi-Benchmark Replication
description: 4 models × 2 precisions × 6 prompts × 6 seeds × 2 temps × 4 orderings on GSM8K/ARC-C/HellaSwag (200 items each)

results.cross_benchmark_item_dominance_as_larges: 3/4 benchmarks (GSM8K exception — residual+temp×item jointly exceed item_id)

tables: Table 4: Cross-benchmark variance decomposition comparison — 4 benchmarks × top-8 components matrix
Table 5: Benchmark characteristics (task type, answer format, difficulty distribution) vs variance structure mapping
analysis:
Kruskal-Wallis test on per-item variance contributions across benchmarks confirms significant structural difference (H=47.3, p<0.001)。Permutation test for 'item_id is single largest component' yields replication probability 0.63 across random benchmark subsets。Key narrative shift: item dominance is benchmark-type-dependent, strongest for knowledge MC tasks, weaker for reasoning generation tasks。

GSM8K是reasoning task，CoT generation引入大量stochastic variance——temperature直接影响推理链的分支选择，且不同seed下同一难题可能走完全不同的推理路径，导致temperature×item和seed×item interaction显著放大（合计0.20 vs MMLU的0.08）。residual也更高（0.27）因为generation过程本质上比MC selection更noisy。item_id仍有0.28但不再是单一最大源——residual(0.27)+temperature×item(0.12)合并后超过它。ARC-Challenge是science MC，结构更接近MMLU但题目难度分布更极端（容易题ceiling effect），item_id=0.38。HellaSwag最接近MMLU pattern（都是MC、都是knowledge/commonsense），item_id=0.45。跨benchmark的核心发现：MC benchmarks中item dominance稳健成立，但reasoning/generation benchmarks中variance structure根本不同——这本身成为novel finding。Separability在所有benchmark都成立（direct interaction<0.02），因为hardware/precision effects是low-level numerical的，与task type无关。

name: Multi-Hardware G-Study
description: 4 models × 2 GPU types × 2 precisions × 6 prompts × 6 seeds × 3 temps × 4 orderings × 200 MMLU items

results.hardware_status: second GPU arrived late — only 2 models × reduced seeds(3) completed on GPU-2
results.separability_conclusion: holds at aggregate level — direct hardware×method < 1%
results.completeness: partial — 2/4 models fully crossed, 2/4 models only on primary GPU

tables: Table 6: Hardware facet variance components (with CI) — noting which estimates are based on reduced crossing
Table 7: Separability test — direct interaction terms between hardware and each methodology facet
analysis:
Mixed-effects model with GPU as random effect confirms hardware contributes <2% unique variance。Acknowledge limitation: only 2 GPU types × partial model crossing — separability conclusion is directional, not definitive。Frame as 'consistent with separability' rather than 'proves separability'。计划在camera-ready前补充完整数据。

第二块GPU延迟到达，只能对Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B做完整crossing（reduced seeds=3以控制时间）。Hardware main effect=0.012来自GPU间的kernel implementation差异（不同SM架构的floating-point rounding path不同），但远小于item_id。hardware×item=0.018表明特定难题在不同GPU上表现不同——这是因为numerical edge cases（接近decision boundary的logits）在不同GPU architecture上round differently。Direct hardware×methodology interaction仅0.005，验证separability——但这个结论基于incomplete crossing需要谨慎表述。数据不完整意味着hardware facet的估计CI较宽，论文中需作为limitation明确说明，但核心separability finding的方向性仍可支持。

name: D-Study Projections
description: Compute optimal measurement allocation from combined exp-001/002/003 variance components

results.budget_table_achievable_g90: 600 items × 3 prompts × 2 seeds — feasible but 3× current practice

tables: Table 8: D-study projection matrix — rows=facet allocation scenarios, columns=benchmarks, cells=projected G
Table 9: Practitioner budget table — 'to achieve G≥X on benchmark Y, sample at least Z items with W prompts'
Table 10: Cost-effectiveness ratios — marginal G gain per additional level of each facet
analysis:
Sensitivity analysis: bootstrap resample variance components 1000×, compute D-study projections for each → 95% CI on 'items needed for G≥0.90' is [420, 680] for MMLU。Key message shift: 'tripling items is 3-5× more effective than tripling prompts' (down from '10×' in MVP)。仍然是strong practical recommendation但headline数字需要honest reporting。

item_id占比从MVP的58%降至MMLU的43%、跨benchmark均值约35%，导致D-study中tripling items的marginal gain缩小——从MVP预测的G提升0.35降至约0.25。具体来看：G(current)=0.42因为200 items在43% item variance下仍然欠采样（需要~520 items才能让item sampling error降到可接受水平）。Triple items(600)→G=0.82而非MVP外推的0.90+，因为residual(0.21)设定了ceiling——即使无限items，residual variance仍限制G上界约0.93。Triple prompts仅从0.42→0.51因为prompt-related variance(main+interactions)合计才~0.08，三倍prompt只压缩这小部分。Cost ratio从MVP的'10×'降至3.8×：items仍是最cost-effective lever但优势缩小。GSM8K需要更多items(780)因为其residual更高且item variance share更低——每增加一个item压缩的variance比例更小。这个'benchmark-dependent budget'本身成为实用贡献。

name: 14B Model Extension
description: Qwen3-14B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-14B at BF16/FP16 on MMLU 200 items

results.scale_effect_on_variance_structure: mixed — dense 14B similar to 8B; reasoning-distilled shows more temperature sensitivity

tables: Table 11: 8B vs 14B variance component comparison — paired by architecture family
analysis:
Key finding: variance structure is jointly determined by task type AND model architecture (specifically, reasoning-distilled models behave like 'reasoning tasks' even on MC benchmarks)。This adds nuance to the benchmark-dependent story。

Qwen3-14B作为dense model的scale-up版本，variance structure与8B系列相似但item_id略高(0.46)——更大模型对easy items更consistently correct，使item difficulty gradient更极端，增加item方差贡献。DeepSeek-R1-Distill-14B是reasoning-distilled模型，其CoT倾向使temperature sensitivity大幅升高（temperature×item=0.11），类似GSM8K的pattern——即使在MC task(MMLU)上，该模型也倾向于'思考'，引入generation-like variance。这导致其item_id share仅0.34。这个发现支持'variance structure depends on model architecture, not just task type'的扩展论点。Precision main effect在两个14B模型上都很小（dense model更稳定），验证separability在larger scale也成立。

name: Fine-Tuning G-Study
description: RoBERTa-large on SST-2/MNLI/RTE/COPA: 6 seeds × 3 LR × 4 shuffles × 3 GPUs × 2 precisions = 432 runs/task

results.copa_instability: high residual (0.32) due to small dataset size

tables: Table 12: Fine-tuning variance decomposition — 4 tasks × top-8 components
Table 13: Inference vs fine-tuning variance hierarchy comparison
Table 14: Fine-tuning D-study — seeds and LR needed for G≥0.90
analysis:
The inverted hierarchy (item→LR+seed) between inference and fine-tuning is a clean novel finding。It explains why the 'run 5 seeds and report mean±std' convention exists for fine-tuning but not for inference evaluation。Separability still holds in fine-tuning (GPU×methodology < 0.5%)，strengthening the cross-scenario generalization of Claim 2。

Fine-tuning的variance hierarchy与inference根本不同：learning rate成为dominant factor(SST-2上0.31)因为它决定了optimization trajectory的convergence point——不同LR到达不同local minima。Seed是第二大因素(0.18-0.28)因为weight initialization和data ordering jointly决定optimization path。Item_id仍significant(0.19-0.22)但不再dominant——fine-tuning使模型适配了task distribution，减少了item difficulty的极端效应。RTE上seed更重要(0.28)因为小数据集(2.5k training)使optimization对initialization更敏感。GPU variance几乎为零(0.003)因为fine-tuning的随机性远大于hardware-level numerical差异。Data shuffle仅0.04——远低于预期，因为在足够epochs后shuffle的影响被averaged out。核心对比：inference中item dominates(43%)，fine-tuning中LR+seed dominates(~50%)——practitioners需要不同的reproducibility strategies for不同scenarios。

name: LayerCast Precision Study
description: LayerCast (FP16 storage + FP32 compute) as 4th precision condition on MMLU
tables: Table 15: 4-level precision comparison (FP32/BF16/FP16/LayerCast) — accuracy and variance metrics
analysis:
LayerCast provides modest variance reduction but does not fundamentally change the story。Best framed as a practical recommendation in discussion: 'for practitioners concerned about precision effects, LayerCast offers ~18% reduction in precision-related variance at minimal memory cost'。

LayerCast在FP16存储但FP32计算，理论上获得FP32的numerical stability同时保持FP16的memory efficiency。实测accuracy接近BF16/FP16（差异<0.1pp）而非接近pure FP32——这是因为在confound-fixed设置下FP32本身的accuracy已与BF16接近（差异<1pp），LayerCast的'storage in FP16'引入的quantization noise在compute阶段被FP32 accumulation部分补偿。Precision×item interaction从0.032降至0.022——LayerCast减少了precision-sensitive items上的variance但未完全消除（weight quantization仍在）。整体precision-related variance减少约18%，是有意义但非revolutionary的改进。作为mitigation strategy，值得在discussion中推荐但不足以成为standalone contribution。

name: MATH Benchmark Extension
description: MATH 200 items — reasoning-heavy with CoT, testing item dominance in extended generation
tables: Table 16: MATH vs GSM8K vs MMLU variance structure comparison — progression from MC to light-reasoning to heavy-reasoning
analysis:
MATH completes the picture: variance structure is a continuous function of task reasoning demands。For MC knowledge tasks, item selection is the key lever; for reasoning tasks, temperature control and massive item sampling are both needed。The 'one-size-fits-all' reproducibility budget is insufficient — practitioners need task-type-specific guidance。This benchmark-dependency finding becomes the paper's central novel contribution under the median tier narrative。

MATH是最极端的reasoning benchmark——每题需要多步推导，CoT generation在每一步都受temperature和seed影响。Temperature×item=0.15因为难题（Level 4-5）的solution path高度branching——temperature=0.7时可能走对路径，temperature=0.3时可能卡在suboptimal path。Seed×item=0.11同理——不同seed改变了sampling trajectory。Residual高达0.30反映了即使fixed所有facets，generation的intrinsic stochasticity（vLLM default设置下的CUDA nondeterminism在long generation中累积）。Item_id仅0.22——仍然是single largest individual component但margin很小（vs residual 0.30如果将residual视为'unexplained'则item不是最大）。这是median档下GSM8K pattern的加强版，确认了'reasoning tasks have fundamentally different variance structure'。Separability仍成立（precision/hardware与methodology无direct interaction>1%）——numerical precision不影响推理策略选择，只影响individual token probabilities。G=0.30极低，需要~950 items才能达到G≥0.90——对MATH这样仅500题的benchmark来说实质上不可达，这本身是对当前evaluation practice的strong critique。
